name: Nijuubako
source:
Among other accessories there are two stories:
1. 『イルとスイの日常』"Il and Sui everyday" is about Il and Sui exploring outer world and own sexuality.
2.『砦に帰す』"Return to the Fort" is about Ayu group expedition sent by Iga ninja to investigate an ancient Yagyuu fort.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
除其他附加内容外，本作还收录两篇故事：

1.《伊露与翠的日常》「イルとスイの日常」讲述伊露与翠探索外部世界及自身性意识的故事。

2.《归返堡垒》「砦に帰す」讲述彩一行受伊贺忍者派遣，远征调查一座古老柳生堡垒的故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
